# Quaternius animal sources (CC0)

Author: **Quaternius**. Source files are retained unmodified:

- `Cow.fbx`, `Horse.fbx`, `Pig.fbx`, `Sheep.fbx` and `License.txt`:
  [Farm Animal Pack](https://opengameart.org/content/lowpoly-animated-farm-animal-pack),
  archive `Farm Animals by @Quaternius.zip` from the author's upload (CC0).
- `Wolf.fbx`: [Animal Pack Vol. 2](https://opengameart.org/content/animated-animales-low-poly),
  archive `Animal Pack Vol.2 by @Quaternius.zip` from the author's upload (CC0).

The `.glb` files are generated reference derivatives written by a full `npm run art:actors` bake.
`Deer.glb` is the original project deer model from `tools/art/actor-models.js`, not Quaternius artwork.
The runtime loads the baked PNG atlases in `game/art/actors/`, not these source models.

CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
See `docs/ACTOR_ASSETS.md` and `tools/art/ACTOR_LICENSE.txt` for full scope and original equipment credits.
